text:
sam: Kicking off a tapered shift 12% -> 30% for release 2026.1. Starting now. Status check in 5m. @ops_oncall please monitor latencies, @lee watch kv-cache. Deploy-bot will post updates.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout started: release=2026.1 cohort=tapered initial_pct=12 target_pct=30 window=45m

jenna: release notes link?

sam: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026.1 — notes in the doc. Key change: quantized-xl + runtime kernel swap.

ops_oncall: seeing small tail p95 bump on canary (eu-west). p95 +120ms over baseline, errors 0.3% -> 0.9%. Holding until probe passes. :warning:

miguel: can you paste the metric snapshot? what threshold triggers auto-hold?

ops_oncall: metrics snapshot:
```
p50 80ms
p95 220ms (+120)
errors 0.9% (+0.6)
kv_cache_miss_rate 3.1% (+1.7)
```

lee: that kv cache miss bump is worrying — we recently changed prefetch timeout on canary. Rolling that flag back could help.

sam: Decision: hold ramp at 12%. @lee please pin canary to previous flag variant and restart pods. If regressions clear in 10m we'll resume. If not, rollback to 2026.0 for cohorts >12%. @anita FYI.

lee: pinned renderer variant v3 -> v2 and restarted pods. deploy-bot confirm?

deploy-bot: [deploy] variant pin applied: service=renderer canary_variant=v2 changed_by=lee

ops_oncall: traffic steady at 12%, retries normalized, p95 down to 150ms, errors 0.5%. Trending down but still above baseline.

jenna: will product need to update changelog if we rollback? any user-facing behavior to call out?

anita: noted. drafting a short note in the release doc. If we abort we'll mention kv-prefetch regression and rollback reason.

sam: Hold for another 8m. If p95 <130ms and errors <0.4% we go/no-go to 30%. Otherwise rollback. @deploy-bot schedule check-in +8m.

deploy-bot: [alert] scheduled check-in at +8m

miguel: also watching edge-1 for 502s, could be unrelated infra ripple.

ops_oncall: edge-1 502 spike resolved after pod restart at 7489998805. No further spikes.

sam: Consensus: proceed to 30% in 8m if metrics hold. If ops requests abort beforehand we'll stop and trigger rollback playbook. :thumbsup:

lee: standing by.

jenna: +1

anita: +1

sam: Thanks — I'll call stop/go at the check-in.
